aboutH2: Trafalgar Medical Detox: Supervised Withdrawal in Halton Hills
intro: Trafalgar Medical Detox, formerly Neworld Medical Detox, is a small residential detox centre in Limehouse, in the Town of Halton Hills. It's run under the Trafalgar Addiction Treatment Centres name, and its job is the first week or so of recovery: getting safely through withdrawal from alcohol, opioids, methadone or other drugs with medical staff watching over you day and night.

Neworld Medical Detox offers a comprehensive and customized medical detox program that provides 24/7 care for clients during the crucial early stages of their recovery journey. The facility offers detoxification treatment for those who are struggling with alcohol, drug, methadone, and opioid addictions. The medical detox program is designed to be as smooth and pain-free as possible to prevent clients from facing any adverse withdrawals symptoms. With a limited number of clients in residence at any given time, Neworld’s team of medical professionals can dedicate their undivided attention and care to ensure that each client receives the appropriate care and support during their recovery.

pillars.title: Location and Amenities
pillars.body: Neworld Medical Detox is conveniently located outside Toronto, providing a peaceful and quiet atmosphere for clients to begin their recovery journey. The facility is situated on 2 acres of land featuring beautiful gardens and green spaces for clients to roam freely. The facility offers private rooms for each client allowing them to have privacy and space as they deal with their substance abuse problems. Furthermore, Neworld is well-equipped with a small fitness center, Playstation area, outdoor pool, sauna, and massage facilities. Besides, the clients also have access to healthy meals to ensure they regain their strength and vitality.

pillars.title: Psychosocial Support
pillars.body: Neworld recognizes that the journey of recovery does not end with detoxification. Therefore, the facility has a psychosocial therapist to help create a discharge plan that will assist clients in transitioning smoothly to their next phase of treatment. The discharge plan is tailored to each client’s specific needs and includes elements such as therapy sessions, group counseling, and support groups as needed. Neworld Medical Detox provides an environment to help clients rebuild their physical, emotional, and social well-being.

pillars.title: Yoga and Reiki
pillars.body: Neworld Medical Detox also offers yoga and reiki practice for its clients. These practices provide clients with an opportunity to embrace a more holistic approach to their recovery journey. By practicing yoga, clients can learn various techniques to manage their stress levels and promote mental health. Reiki is another helpful practice that can help clients reduce their anxiety and depression, which can be triggers for substance abuse. These practices help clients in acquiring healthy living skills and fostering inner emotional and physical wellness to improve their overall health and well-being.

overview: The Neworld Medical Detox is a leading provider of addiction services, catering to the unique needs of each client. With a focus on professional detox, they ensure a seamless entry into the longer-term treatment program of their choice. Neworld’s services bridge the gap in addiction services and provide clients with the attention and care they need for a successful recovery.

location.heading: Trafalgar Medical Detox in Limehouse, Ontario
location.intro: Trafalgar Medical Detox is on a quiet 2-acre property at 13604 6th Line in Limehouse, a hamlet in the Town of Halton Hills between Georgetown and Acton, on the western edge of the GTA. It's about 50 minutes by car from downtown Toronto and roughly 35 minutes from Pearson airport, while Brampton, Milton and Guelph are each around half an hour away.

faqIntro: Answers come from the centre's listing and its own website. Still unsure? Call, it's free and confidential.

faqs.q: How much does Trafalgar Medical Detox cost?
faqs.a: Recovery.com estimates a stay at $4,900 to $7,600. The centre doesn't post prices on its own website, and the final cost depends on how many days your withdrawal takes, so ask admissions for a quote before you arrive. Detox is private pay, and OHIP doesn't cover it.

Most people stay 5 to 7 days. Trafalgar says the length depends on the person, and you're discharged once a doctor decides you're no longer medically at risk. You are supervised around the clock for the whole stay.

faqs.q: Is this a rehab program or only detox?
faqs.a: It's detox only. Trafalgar Medical Detox manages withdrawal, and the centre itself says detox on its own isn't treatment for addiction. When you're medically stable you can move directly into the residential program at Trafalgar Addiction Treatment Centres in Erin, or into the outpatient care of your choice.

faqs.q: Do I need medical detox before rehab?
faqs.a: Not always. Trafalgar screens you by phone before admission to decide if you need medical or non-medical detox. People who have been clean and sober for at least 72 hours before admission usually don't need any further detox.

faqs.q: Where is Trafalgar Medical Detox and how do I get there?
faqs.a: The centre is at 13604 6th Line in Limehouse, a rural hamlet in the Town of Halton Hills between Georgetown and Acton. Most people come by car: it's about 50 minutes from downtown Toronto and roughly 35 minutes from Pearson airport. Brampton, Milton and Guelph are each about half an hour away.

faqs.q: Is Trafalgar Medical Detox the same place as Neworld Medical Detox?
faqs.a: Yes. Neworld Medical Detox now runs as Trafalgar Medical Detox, and its old website, neworlddetox.com, forwards to Trafalgar's detox page. The address on 6th Line in Limehouse is the same.

faqs.q: Will OHIP or private insurance pay for detox?
faqs.a: OHIP doesn't pay, because this is a private-pay centre. Trafalgar's FAQ says most private insurers recognize its treatment and that staff will help with the paperwork for a claim, so check with your benefits provider what your plan covers for detox.

faqs.q: What kinds of substance addictions does Neworld Medical Detox treat?
faqs.a: Neworld Medical Detox offers detoxification treatment for alcohol, drug, methadone, and opioid addictions.

faqs.q: What kind of care do clients receive during the early stages of their recovery journey?
faqs.a: Clients receive 24/7 care during the early stages of their recovery journey at Neworld Medical Detox.

faqs.q: What kind of amenities are available at Neworld Medical Detox?
faqs.a: Neworld Medical Detox offers private rooms, a small fitness center, a Playstation area, outdoor pool, sauna, and massage facilities.

faqs.q: What kind of medical professionals does Neworld Medical Detox have on staff?
faqs.a: Neworld Medical Detox has a team of medical professionals who can provide clients with the appropriate care and support during their recovery.

faqs.q: How is Neworld Medical Detox's medical detox program tailored to each individual client?
faqs.a: Neworld Medical Detox offers a customized medical detox program based on each client’s unique needs.

faqs.q: How many clients are in residence at Neworld Medical Detox at any given time?
faqs.a: Neworld Medical Detox only admits a limited number of clients in residence at any given time to ensure that each client receives the appropriate care and support during their recovery.
